text.title: Django Services Layer Failure Modes
text.summary: 8 antipatterns observed in real deployments. Each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: View body contains 60+ lines of business logic across 3 models; nothing in services.py.
antipattern.root-cause: Logic written inline because 'services felt like overengineering'.
antipattern.fix: Extract into entity_action service; view becomes 5-line dispatch.

antipattern.symptom: Email task fires for an order that doesn't yet exist; rollback leaves an orphan email sent.
services/orders.py imports HttpRequest so that order_create() can read user.id off the request.
antipattern.root-cause: The author short-cut the refactor by threading the whole request through instead of extracting the primitive.
antipattern.fix: Pass user_id into the service as a primitive. Add an import-linter contract: services/ may not import django.http.*.

antipattern.symptom: Views still call Model.objects.create(...) for some 'small' operations after a partial refactor.
antipattern.root-cause: Partial migration; the 'simple' operations never moved into services.
antipattern.fix: Sweep with a codemod that finds Model.objects.(create|save|delete) outside services/. Route each call through a service function.

antipattern.symptom: Services named create_order, update_user, etc. Project mixes both conventions.
antipattern.fix: Rename to order_create, user_update; document the convention in project AGENTS.md.

antipattern.symptom: Services organised as services/views.py, services/admin.py, services/tasks.py — the same aggregate logic duplicated in each.
antipattern.root-cause: Module structure mirrors the callers instead of the aggregates.
antipattern.fix: Reorganise by aggregate: services/orders.py, services/payments.py. Each function is then callable from any number of caller types.

antipattern.symptom: All tests go through the Django test client; the service layer is never called directly.
antipattern.root-cause: Habit from the fat-view era — the client test covers everything, slowly.
antipattern.fix: Add direct pytest tests against service functions with pydantic/dataclass inputs. Keep client tests only for HTTP-layer concerns (auth, content type).

antipattern.symptom: Every service is wrapped in @transaction.atomic, including read-only.
antipattern.fix: Remove @atomic from single-write and read-only services.
